_comment: Adaptive SEO state — tracks per-URL rewrite history + cooldowns. Updated by .github/scripts/adaptive-seo.mjs on every run. DO NOT edit by hand unless rolling back.

url.currentTargetTerm: string — the trending term currently targeted in title/meta
url.currentTermVolume: number — relative search volume score 0-100 (from Google Autocomplete rank)
url.lastRewriteDate: ISO date string — when the SEO was last rewritten for this URL

variantHistory.reason: string — why the rewrite was made
